# Code of Conduct

## Our Pledge

We are committed to making participation in our community a harassment-free experience for everyone, regardless of age, body size, disability, ethnicity, gender identity, experience level, nationality, appearance, race, religion, or sexual identity and orientation.

## Our Standards

### Examples of behavior that contributes to a positive environment

- Using welcoming and inclusive language
- Being respectful of differing viewpoints and experiences
- Giving and gracefully accepting constructive feedback
- Taking responsibility, apologizing, and learning from mistakes

### Examples of unacceptable behavior

- Harassment, discrimination, or hateful conduct
- Personal attacks, insults, or threats
- Publishing others' private information without explicit permission
- Any conduct that is reasonably considered inappropriate in a professional setting

## Enforcement Responsibilities

Maintainers are responsible for clarifying and enforcing our standards of acceptable behavior and may take appropriate action in response to unacceptable behavior, including warnings, content removal, or temporary/permanent bans.

## Scope

This Code of Conduct applies to all community spaces, including issues, pull requests, discussions, reviews, and other project-related communication channels.

## Reporting

If you experience or witness unacceptable behavior, report it to the maintainers using the contact channels in `SECURITY.md` or other project contact methods.
All reports will be reviewed promptly and handled confidentially whenever possible.

## Attribution

This template is based on Contributor Covenant.
